publication: Local commits only; no push, tag, package publication or deployment.

implemented.profile: Explicit Rust rich V3 compiler; V2 structural grammar plus optional closed layout metadata on paragraph/heading/code only. No old constructor or SDK default selects V3.
implemented.fields: Alignment1=start,2=center,3=end,4=justify,5=physical-left,6=physical-right; direction1=ltr,2=rtl,3=auto; indent0..12; line-height percentage100..300. Absence is inheritance, not a filled default.
implemented.mutation: Named guarded SetBlockLayout action and atomic change_selection_layout. Native coverage owns every covered text block including empty boundaries and code. One content history unit, no inline-pending change, exact original selection. No text targets refuses.
implemented.intent: Closed native decoder: omitted field keeps, null removes, value sets. Strict types/tokens/bounds, duplicate/unknown field refusal, no caller target list or arbitrary CSS, independent64KiB budget.
implemented.reads: Typed independent mixed-state read and separate breditor/rich-block-layout-state version1; uniform-null retains inheritance. Read does not publish or inherit the mutation operation ceiling.
implemented.retention: Heading/code conversion and text/list/task splits preserve native layout; joins retain left layout and exact inverse source. Rich image-caption clipboard roundtrip/rekey/paste retains layout. Fresh code-exit paragraph starts with absent layout.
implemented.atomicity: Stale/read-only, old profile, no targets, transaction ceilings and a late property-count failure leave the owner unchanged.
